source_basis.relationship: Unchanged actual grammar: FILE --to-room ROOM with optional --type, --title, repeatable --exclude and --save-as. There is no --from-room.

Existing type-before-title branch precedence, title admission before target resolution, direct IoData.Pr writes, exact text reports and report-before-save behavior. XmlEditCmd::Move keeps its normal helper behavior but remains dry-run unsupported.

Existing type helper resolves target first, selects case-insensitive exact C types with direct IoData, applies exclusions, keeps pre-order UUID duplicates and counts zero/already-matching items. Target room lookup keeps substring/exact preference, duplicates, empty UUID and errors. Qualified RoomRename behavior is not changed.
Unchanged general title/UUID/gid/type selectors, bracket-room filtering, UUID mirror de-duplication, missing-UUID handling and ordered admission errors in the title branch.
Unchanged normal serialization/default/BOM/line-ending and content-change-dependent Document stamp; never reached by preview.
Fail-closed admission is extended only to ConfigCmd::Control(ControlCmd::Move); other unaudited mutations remain rejected before startup effects.

hash_basis: Exact committed baseline LF Git blobs, not CRLF working-tree bytes.

historical_artifacts.status: Byte-identical historical evidence, including its former qualified-selector behavior; not rewritten.
Byte-identical source-only qualified-room-rename correction; behavior remains unchanged.

plan.sharing: One private immutable ControlMovePlan feeds preview_control_move, move_control and the unchanged public move_to_room signature/tuple result. No DOM clone or mutate-then-discard path.
plan.selection: Effective typed selector plus supplied excludes, actual selected object attributes/paths and direct IoData attributes/paths. Type wins over title; exclusions only affect type. Missing direct IoData remains an empty list in the admitted title branch.
plan.transitions: Raw target and resolved UUID; before_pr null versus empty; after_pr exact UUID; created means missing Pr attribute only, not room or IoData creation. changed does not suppress normal saves. Type duplicates and ancestor/descendant pre-order paths remain stable under attribute-only writes.
plan.boundary: Preview returns before mutation, serialization/defaults, stamps, save, destination probing or directory creation; startup bypasses cache/network/telemetry writes. Includes zero matches, no-ops, failures and existing/missing-parent save-as paths.
plan.output: JSON dry_run and optional trace_id; JSON-valued table/CSV cells, quiet table summary and no-header conventions. Normal report/save output is unchanged even under JSON/CSV/quiet.

regressions: rooms.rs control_move_tests: baseline algorithm differential for title/type precedence/exclusion/general/qualified selectors, full DOM and serialization parity, unchanged public helper result, nested paths and UUID mirrors, duplicate IoData, missing/empty Pr and empty target UUID, zero/multiple/no-IoData/already-matching cases, exact error order and nonmutation.

tests/dry_run.rs control_move tests: actual identities and transitions, JSON/trace/table/CSV/quiet/no-header, complete bytes/mtime/permissions/directory/cache/token/telemetry snapshots and zero mock network requests; all save-as destinations, failures/no-ops and parser rejection of invented --from-room.

tests/dry_run.rs normal control writer: complete planned/written DOM parity, UUID/category/wiring/flags/unknowns/unmatched preservation, legacy text output/report-before-failed-save, overwrite, BOM/CRLF and conditional stamp on changed versus zero/no-op/no-IoData edits.
Existing room rename, qualified-selector, dry-run, move helper and config integration suites remain in place; control rename/wire/unwire, room add and config xml move stay fail-closed.
limits: Raw existing CLI source provenance only. No native UI, room-family, whole-file, SPS or physical-effect claim; no lab/VM/Notebook/SDK/SSH/time/host actions, extraction, new framework or unrelated behavior changes.
